description: The security architecture standard shipped with sdem-security: rules on NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 controls, checked by sdem comply.

standard.title: Security architecture standard (sdem-security)
standard.source: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 and CSF 2.0 (public domain); security/docs/security-aspect-spec.md §6
standard.note: SEC-S07 (security requirements met by a control) and SEC-S08 (audit control on components that access personal data) follow paths SDEM rules cannot express; sdem security review checks them.

rules.message: personal data is classified confidential or restricted (SC-28, PR.DS)
personal data is protected by at least one control (SC-28 at rest — sdem security review names any without one)
an internet-facing interface authenticates its callers with oauth2, OpenID Connect or mutual TLS (IA-2, IA-8, PR.AA)
a communication path is encrypted (SC-8, PR.DS)
a communication path names its protocol (SC-8, PR.DS)
a DMZ — the internet edge — is bounded by a trust boundary (SC-7, PR.IR)
an implemented control shows its evidence (CA-2, ID.IM)
a control in place says what enforces it (CA-2)
a high-impact threat is mitigated by a control — or accepted under a person's exception (RA-3, RA-7, ID.RA)
a high-likelihood threat is mitigated by a control — or accepted under a person's exception (RA-3, RA-7, ID.RA)
a critical business process is protected by at least one control — separation of duties, authorisation (AC-5, AC-3, GV.RR) — S1
personal data states how long it is kept (SI-12 information retention, PR.DS) — S3
an internet-facing interface is protected by a control — authorisation per operation, input validation (AC-3, SI-10, PR.AA) — S4
an application states its recovery time and recovery point, so backup and recovery can be designed (CP-9, CP-10, RC.RP) — S4
system software states when its support ends, so unsupported components are seen (SA-22, SI-2, ID.AM-08) — S5
